source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Remove AC power
2. Check if system power LED is OFF
3. Insert MB and plug AC power cord
4. Check if system power LED is blinking with Green when AC on
5. Check if system power LED is Green after system boot into OS
6. Power off system and check if system power LED is Amber without blinking
7. Check if power LED is Fast blinking with Amber when system with error  ( Include Memory error, PCI Error, CPU error, Post error, Temp event, Fan fail, Voltage event, Thermal event, PSU fault, HDD fault, Critical IRQ, CATERR, other system events )

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. System power LED should be OFF when removed AC power
2. System power LED should be blinking with Green when AC on and system should auto power on.
3. System power LED should be Green without blinking after boot into OS.
4. System power LED should be Amber without blinking  when system is off
5. System power LED should be Fast blinking with Amber when system have error

original_test_intent: Validate the visible system power/status LED in no-AC, AC-applied auto-power, OS-running, soft-off and system-error states, including the listed error domains.
original_method: A qualified operator performs the approved AC/board sequence, boots and powers down the SUT, induces each in-scope error using its authorized method, and visually records LED color and blink behavior while the agent may correlate power, boot and fault telemetry.
manual_activity: An operator must control AC/board handling and visually distinguish off, green blinking, green steady, amber steady and amber fast blinking. Each physical fault stimulus must follow an approved procedure.
required_inputs: Meaning and exact safe sequence for Insert MB
LED location, color and blink-rate specification plus observation windows
Definitive in-scope fault list with bounded stimulus and recovery for every required class
Electrical/ESD controls, console/OOB recovery, operator and one-user approval
safety_requirements: Do not remove/apply AC or manipulate a board until the exact de-energized sequence and ESD controls are approved.
Do not invent memory, PCIe, CPU, POST, thermal, fan, voltage, PSU, disk, IRQ or CATERR injection methods.
Stop on unsafe power/thermal state, loss of OOB, boot failure or unrecoverable fault and retain the first observation.
No automatic retry, fault escalation or generalized application of the Seq 182 decision.
agent_execution_scope: While blocked, only inventory read-only power, boot, BMC/SEL and LED-spec inputs.
After unblocking, correlate operator timestamps/photos with power, POST, OS and fault telemetry.
Report each state separately without claiming physical observation or verdict.
engineer_actions: Resolve Insert MB and approve the AC/board sequence.
Define scope plus safe stimulus/recovery for each required error class.
Perform physical/visual work, restore the system and issue the verdict.

modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record board, BIOS, BMC, CPLD and PSU firmware versions.

modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A telemetry fault indication cannot prove physical LED color or blink rate.

project_override_considerations: A project may explicitly select applicable error classes and approved stimuli. The report must name the reduced plan and must not claim that omitted source-listed fault coverage was completed.
expected_evidence: Approved AC/MB and LED-state specification, auto-power setting and fault matrix
Timestamped physical LED evidence for every normal state and approved fault
Per-fault recovery, final system health and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source is underspecified rather than internally contradictory: Insert MB and the error matrix lack executable meaning, while the stated LED expectations can coexist.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The necessary board manipulation and broad error-injection semantics cannot be performed safely or reproducibly without owner definitions. This is a genuine operational block, not merely missing project performance data.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Change NO/MANUAL framing to BLOCKED because it overlooks unsafe undefined operations.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates the eventual MANUAL ONLY visual boundary from the current semantic/safety block.

review_improvement: Prevents a generic AC-cycle/LED exercise from falsely covering undefined motherboard handling and eleven-plus distinct error domains.
independent_technical_reasoning: Physical observation alone does not make the case executable: the source requires an unexplained board insertion and fast-amber validation across heterogeneous faults whose injection can damage or strand the SUT. Those missing operation semantics meet the narrow V3.1 BLOCKED threshold.
